Cite eyetrajectories

Source: SITE_CITATION.md

The public eyetrajectories 0.4.3 source release is archived in Zenodo. Cite the version you actually used, so readers can reproduce analyses with the relevant source code.

Recommended citation

Balaskas, S. (2026). eyetrajectories (Version 0.4.3) [Computer software]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24288857

  • Version: 0.4.3
  • Persistent identifier: 10.5281/zenodo.24288857
  • Release: GitHub v0.4.3
  • Exact qualified source SHA-256: 38f7b8eb05c71c3a0c4c266cc590b9afdb73906b0d9412cf52185523f649da5e
  • Source qualification: Six-platform R CMD check results

BibTeX

@software{balaskas_eyetrajectories_2026_24288857,
  author = {Balaskas, Stefanos},
  title = {eyetrajectories},
  version = {0.4.3},
  year = {2026},
  publisher = {Zenodo},
  doi = {10.5281/zenodo.24288857},
  url = {https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24288857}
}

The GitHub repository also includes a machine-readable CITATION.cff for GitHub’s Cite this repository feature.

Publication boundary: The Zenodo DOI certifies a persistent research software record. It is not evidence of CRAN acceptance or independent scientific validation of the package’s every estimator.
